# A slot's `.empty` and its fallback, executed on every target rather than
# read off a golden. fallback.sngl: content of several statements, a loop
# over nothing and content holding only an effect each show the fallback and
# answer empty, and the effect still mounts. entry.sngl: a component entry a
# population forwards is answered by what the component inserting the
# population populated it with, and a slot that content forwards by the
# caller's content for it. Each test reads the answer through a prop of the
# component asking, which a compiled test answers as the splice does.
#
# testdata/slot_empty_agrees_with_fallback.txtar and slot_empty_entry.txtar
# are the code.

sngl test fallback.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test entry.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

sngl test --platform=html fallback.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test --platform=html entry.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

sngl test --platform=bubbletea fallback.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test --platform=bubbletea entry.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

sngl test --platform=fyne fallback.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=fyne entry.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform=gtk4 fallback.sngl
stdout 'ok'
sngl test --platform=gtk4 entry.sngl
stdout 'ok'

sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric fallback.sngl
stdout 'PASS'
sngl test --platform=android --opt testRunner=robolectric entry.sngl
stdout 'PASS'

-- fallback.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component card(content ...component node) node {
    text #asked(value=content.empty ? "empty" : "full")
    vbox {
        content {
            text(value="fallback")
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var a = false
    var b = false
    var xs list[int] = []
    var mounted = 0
    card #two {
        if a {
            text(value="a")
        }
        if b {
            text(value="b")
        }
    }
    card #loop {
        for var x = xs {
            text(value="{x}")
        }
    }
    card #lifetime {
        effect(@mount { mounted = mounted + 1 })
    }
    button #show(text="show", @click {
        b = true
        xs = [7]
    })
}

func testIt(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.two.asked.value == "empty")
    t.assert(c.loop.asked.value == "empty")
    t.assert(c.lifetime.asked.value == "empty")
    t.assert(c.mounted == 1)
    c.show.click()
    t.assert(c.two.asked.value == "full")
    t.assert(c.loop.asked.value == "full")
}

window {
    main
}
-- entry.sngl --
import . "sngl:ui"
import . "sngl:test"

component boxed(content ...component node) node {
    text #asked(value=content.empty ? "empty" : "full")
    content
}

component frame(layout component(content component node) node) node {
    layout {
        component content {
            text(value="inner")
        }
    }
}

component framed(inner ...component node, layout component(content component node) node) node {
    layout {
        component content {
            inner
        }
    }
}

component main node {
    var shown = false
    frame #f {
        component layout(content) {
            boxed #direct {
                content
            }
        }
    }
    framed #g {
        component layout(content) {
            boxed #forwarded {
                content
            }
        }
        if shown {
            text(value="shown")
        }
    }
    button #show(text="show", @click { shown = true })
}

func testIt(t Test, c main) {
    t.assert(c.f.direct.asked.value == "full")
    t.assert(c.g.forwarded.asked.value == "empty")
    c.show.click()
    t.assert(c.g.forwarded.asked.value == "full")
}

window {
    main
}
